method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Oil eyes weekly drop on Hormuz deal hopes; AI sends stocks to record highs
Equities.reason: Combines two dominant equity impulses: Mideast ceasefire optimism lifting risk appetite and AI-led leadership pushing index highs. High relevance because it ties geopolitical derisking to the market-wide rally driven by AI names.

Equities.title: S&P 500 and Nasdaq hit record closing highs as US and Iran agree to extend ceasefire
Equities.reason: Direct evidence of broad market regime move to risk-on after US‑Iran truce reports; reinforces the view that geopolitical derisking is allowing AI/software leaders to lift indices to records.

Equities.title: Dell rallies about 40% on strong Nvidia‑powered AI server demand
Equities.reason: Idiosyncratic stock move that signals concentrated upside in AI hardware exposure; supports the narrative that AI capex is driving outsized gains in a handful of large-cap tech suppliers.

Equities.title: Snowflake surges 36% for best day ever on AI frenzy, fueling software rally
Equities.summary: The Snowflake rally also lifted shares of ServiceNow, Oracle and Palantir, while Salesforce bucked the trend.
Equities.reason: Large software-name rally tied explicitly to AI adoption; indicates breadth within tech/software rally beyond pure semiconductor names and reinforces sector leadership theme.

Equities.title: Anthropic's valuation surges to $965 billion, surpassing OpenAI
Equities.reason: Big private-market financing and sky-high AI valuations underscore froth/adoption narrative that is seeding public-equity enthusiasm for AI exposure; reinforces thematic dominance of AI.

Equities.title: Gap, American Eagle fall as weak apparel demand signals constrained consumer spending
Equities.reason: Clear negative signal for consumer discretionary and market breadth: retail earnings/data showing weak apparel demand suggest constrained consumer spending and a potential headwind to cyclicals if persistent.

Equities.title: Nvidia is investing billions into this emerging technology that could change the AI industry
Equities.summary: Photonics is considered to be a more efficient alternative to the current process of transferring data using electricity, which could be crucial to the AI boom.
Equities.reason: Confirms durable, long‑term investment cycle underpinning AI hardware demand (supports semiconductor and infrastructure leaders). Relevant as fundamental support for continued sector strength.

Equities.title: Asian stocks rally, KOSPI hits record highs on US-Iran peace optimism, tech gains
Equities.summary: Asian equities gain ground on Friday as market sentiment was buoyed by reports of a tentative 60-day ceasefire extension between the United States (US) and Iran.
Equities.reason: Regional confirmation that Mideast derisking is translating into global risk-on flows, lifting Asian markets and tech-heavy indices — supports the cross-market narrative of geopolitical news boosting equities.

Equities.title: Trading Day: Stocks sizzle on ceasefire extension
Equities.reason: Market commentary tying ceasefire extension directly to strong equity internals; useful intra-day confirmation that geopolitical developments are a primary driver of today's rally rather than purely fundamentals.

Rates.title: Inflation-Wary Investors Pour Into Short-Dated Bond Funds
Rates.reason: Fund flows into short-dated bond funds reflect investor fear of persistent inflation/higher rates and duration hedging — supportive of a higher-yield, lower-price environment for longer-duration bonds.

Rates.summary: Minutes of the Federal Open Market Committee, April 28-29, 2026
Rates.reason: FOMC minutes are a primary signal for policy path; recent minutes have supported a view of persistent rate risk — net hawkish / higher-for-longer implication for yields (negative for bond prices).

Rates.summary: Minutes of the Board's discount rate meeting on April 20 and 29, 2026

Rates.title: Gita Gopinath on Why Interest Rates Have Surged All Around the World

Crypto.reason: Large, sustained outflows from US BTC ETFs are a clear liquidity and demand negative for the on‑ramp to spot bitcoin, amplifying downside pressure across crypto markets and signalling risk‑off behavior from institutional/retail ETF investors.
